title: FBR Due Dates in Pakistan: Income Tax, Sales Tax and Withholding
description: A plain guide to the main FBR deadlines: income tax return, advance tax, federal sales tax and withholding statements, with notes on extensions.
lead: A plain guide to the main FBR deadlines: income tax return, advance tax, federal sales tax and withholding statements, with notes on extensions.
body:
Most FBR penalties come from missed dates, not from complex law. This guide lists the main deadlines and how they work. Dates were checked on 1 November 2026, but FBR changes them by notification, so confirm before you rely on one.

Income tax return

  • Individuals and AOPs: 30 September.
  • Companies with a 30 June year-end: 31 December.

Both dates are on FBR's income tax due-dates page. For tax year 2026, FBR extended the date for individuals and AOPs from 30 September to 15 October and then to 31 October 2026. If your year-end is not 30 June, you have a special tax year with its own dates, so ask your adviser.

Advance tax

Taxpayers who pay advance tax under section 147 pay in four quarterly instalments. FBR's advance tax calendar shows the 15th of September, December, March and June for individuals and AOPs. Guides give companies the 25th of September, December and March, then 15 June, while FBR's own page shows different company dates. Where sources differ, pay by the earlier date and confirm with your adviser.

Federal sales tax

FBR's sales tax due-dates page gives this monthly pattern for the month after the tax period:

  • 10th: Annexure-C
  • 15th: payment
  • 18th: e-filed return

CNG dealers, brick makers, power and gas companies and manufacturers' annual returns follow special dates. Sales tax on services in Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan is collected by the provincial authorities with their own dates.

Withholding tax statements

Withholding agents file a monthly statement by the 15th of the following month. See our guide to withholding tax in Pakistan for the sections and rates.

If a date falls on a weekend

Some guides say the date usually moves to the next working day. Do not assume this; check the FBR notice or file a day early.

Keep a calendar

Our free FBR Due Dates Calendar lists your dates for the next 6 to 18 months, shows extensions, and can be saved to Excel or your phone calendar.

Sources: FBR income tax due dates, FBR sales tax due dates, Dawn on the 31 October 2026 extension.
